Zoe (People Ops): FYI — Carl's new PM (Aria) starts Tue 9am PT. Dropping a compact manager checklist + who-to-ask.
Carl (Eng Manager): Great, thanks Zoe. Plan: 20m intro + 30m team sync. Can we get device and repo access beforehand?
June (IT): Device order placed. Carl — MacBook Pro 13 or Linux? Also which Slack channels and SSO groups?
Carl (Eng Manager): MacBook Pro 13, no dock. Add to #pm, #product-sync, and #infra. SSO groups: jira-edit, gh-org, aws-staging-read.
Zoe (People Ops): Manager compact checklist:
```
Before Day1: Okta + device, Slack invite, payroll forms, upload signed offer to people-ops-private.
Day1: 9am manager intro, buddy meet, SSO + MFA smoke test.
Day2: dev env + repo access, first small task assigned.
Week1: daily short 1:1s, runbooks + team walkthru, set 30/60/90 goals.
30/60/90 sample: 30 - learn services & deliver small task; 60 - own a backlog area; 90 - lead a measurable improvement.
```
Tara (Buddy): I'll be Aria's buddy. I'll send a "first week map" and schedule a 1pm coffee on Day1.
Omar (Security): We'll do a 15m credential hygiene runthrough Mon afternoon and share a 2-page cheat sheet.
June (IT): Sandbox account provisioned; I'll DM ephemeral token flow and confirm laptop imaging ETA (Fri EOD).
Carl (Eng Manager): Adding feedback checkpoints: day3 quick sync, week2 review, week4 formal. Also assigning a low-risk ticket to land by day3.
Zoe (People Ops): Added feedback cadence. OnboardBot: checklist created https://onboard.example/2201234567 :tada:
Carl (Eng Manager): Thanks everyone. Anything else to add?
Tara (Buddy): Add calendar timezone visibility note — avoid first-week missed invites. Small but saves time.
Zoe (People Ops): Good call, added. See you all on Tue to welcome Aria :smile:
